description: Tutorial catalogue for the pure V1.0.0 release tree. Working V1 tutorials live under tutorials/v1; older replaced files live under tutorials/old. Labels are release-runner policy, not core solver contracts.

gate_definitions.v1_smoke: Fast, stable tutorial run on every release check.
gate_definitions.v1_release: Normal V1 release tutorial; should pass under lm2_baseline.
gate_definitions.v1_extended: Valid V1 tutorial but slower; run for fuller confidence.
gate_definitions.v1_partial_recovery: Partial-recovery tutorial where exact recovery is not required; recovery quality must be reported.
gate_definitions.v1_slow_demo: Working demo that is too slow for the default release gate.
gate_definitions.optional_lm3: Valid tutorial that requires 3-gram language-model assets beyond lm2_baseline.
gate_definitions.broken_contract_fix_needed: Tutorial or helper has an API mismatch; exclude until fixed.
gate_definitions.wrapper_script_fix_needed: Wrapper/import script issue; exclude until fixed.
gate_definitions.remove_from_pure_release: Unwanted in pure release tree; remove only after explicit review.

lm2_baseline.description: Minimal useful release profile with 1/2-gram LM assets.

lm3_extended.description: Optional profile for tutorials that explicitly require 3-gram language-model assets.

tutorials.title: Two-period cribs: fast public walkthrough
tutorials.notes: Fast exact public API walkthrough; three deterministic exact runs measured at 1.615-1.686 seconds of solver wall time.

tutorials.title: Two-period cribs: genuine P13/P31 d14 search
tutorials.notes: Genuine non-zero d14 staged search; three deterministic exact runs measured at 259.825-260.715 seconds and therefore classified extended.

tutorials.title: Start here: Vigenere wrapper and general-map beam solve
